text: Seedlings are started in a potting mix rather than sown directly, using a blend of roughly 1 part topsoil, 2 parts finished compost, and 3-4 parts rice husk ash, filled into small nursery bags or pots. A simple shade shelter (raised roof, open sides, about 2-2.5 m high) is built over the nursery area so seedlings get filtered light and rain protection while germinating.
